# pipoke

> Utils to acquire stuff from pypi and interrogate it

- [pipoke.pkg_vs_words](_autosummary/pipoke.pkg_vs_words.html.md): Compare package names with words (e.g. which package names are also dictionary words).
- [pipoke.pypi_store](_autosummary/pipoke.pypi_store.html.md): A mapping view to pypi projects
- [pipoke.word_conditions](_autosummary/pipoke.word_conditions.html.md): Small predicates on words, used to characterize package names.
